purpose: Separate some curriculum and optimization-budget effects from the GNN-versus-endpoint architecture comparison.
selection: Seeded top 52 of 256 full-trajectory returns; ties shuffled before stable sort. From each elite trajectory take its first 12 state-action pairs, then draw each of 8 batches of 256 pairs with replacement from the 624-pair pool.
optimizer: AdamW learning rate 0.0003, weight decay 0.0001, cross-entropy on chosen actions, gradient norm clip 1.0; all families use the same settings without tuning.
checkpoint_selection: Best n14 validation mean across the 20 events; earliest event wins exact ties. No stage transitions or cross-size validation.
train_seed_rule: The existing rollout formula using seed argument 200+training_seed, iteration, n14 and episode index; all four families receive the same episode seed list.
validation_seed_rule: The existing validation formula with seed argument 200+training_seed; it adds 10000 before the rollout formula. Validation seeds are fresh at each fifth iteration.
unsupported: MLP n40 is excluded, not scored as a failure.
primary_comparison: GNN minus endpoint exact-success rate at n24, paired by the five common training seeds
secondary_comparisons: n24 optimality ratio and absolute gap
GNN minus candidate and MLP at n24
GNN minus endpoint and candidate at n40
uncertainty: Five training seeds are the replication unit. Paired t intervals with four degrees of freedom; secondary intervals descriptive and unadjusted. No extra seeds after seeing outcomes.
resource_contract: Each run has exactly 25600 terminal training rollouts at the same size, 2000 validation rollouts, 800 optimizer updates, 62400 selected elite-prefix pairs and 204800 optimizer pair presentations. Total construction actions may differ because episodes have different lengths; track them explicitly.
limits: This is a new fixed-size CEM variant with truncated elite prefixes and replacement sampling. It matches rollout, size, validation and update exposure but not total environment actions, feature information, parameter count or model optimization difficulty. The n24/40 benchmarks and the old results were already inspected, so this is explanatory rather than pristine confirmation.
